description:
## [1.35.0](https://github.com/dhrubonai/morphe-patches/releases/tag/v1.35.0) (2026-10-29)

### Bug Fixes

* **MovieBox - All-In-One:** complete rewrite ported from hxreborn v1.66.0-dev.2. Fixes: bypass blacklisted device ids, play HD-only titles, list direct links for HD downloads, tag every request with X-Client-Build, block hot patches, remove server update notices, report missing hook class on screen. Added support for 4.0.03.1028.03. **Users must re-patch their MovieBox APK.**
